what: On-device A/B of the tiearb2 TIE ARBITER on the Pixel 9 Pro: champion-as-deployed vs champion+arbiter, measuring seconds and joules per move and per FIRED ply. Replaces the desktop-derived rho_phone bound (5.520 at B=16, measurement/tiearb2_stage2_20260817/PHASE_A.md §1) with measured phone numbers.
owner_authorization: 2026-08-17, verbatim: "in the meantime. let's also get some AB testing on pixel. 100.64.4.100:34993"

governance.note: This is a COST measurement. It prices arbitration work along the champion trajectory and licenses nothing about strength or deploy.

design.why: The arbiter changes the returned action at tied plies by design, so free-running arms would diverge and the move-hash identity gate would (correctly) abort. Instead every arm applies last_move()['tiearb_champ_pick'] -- the champion's own pooled_q_argmax pick -- so the armed arm performs ALL arbitration work (tie detection, CRN world set, B x arms tier-1 playouts) at exactly the positions the champion line visits, while the trajectory stays identical across arms. The identity gate therefore keeps its FULL strength on this axis rather than being downgraded.
design.identity_gate: move_hash over {schema, rules_profile, replay, k_dets, sims_per_det, full applied-action trace}. Unchanged in strength; `replay` added so a future change of replay policy invalidates cross-session comparisons.
design.not_measured: What the arbiter's PICKS are worth. That is the Stage-2 Phase-B game cell, not this bench.

arms.role: the rung PHASE_A called the only phone-affordable one (rho_phone(2) = 0.690 predicted)

workload_knobs.source: governance/PRODUCTION.yaml deploy_profiles.mobile, resolved by android_bridge._Session exactly as the app does; ONLY rust_threads and the tiearb_* SearchConfig fields are overridden by the bench
workload_knobs.budget: k8x1376 (YAML champion budget; sims/k_dets not overridden)
workload_knobs.backend: rust (carc_rs); the bench refuses to measure the python fallback

liveness_gates.j13_equivalent: carc_bench._BenchSession._assert_tiearb reads the RESOLVED arbiter block back off FairAgentRs.stats() and compares field-by-field to the arm's request; a mismatch raises. An armed run that fires on 0 tile plies is reported ok:false. Both exist because a stale carc_rs wheel would otherwise play an ordinary champion and report 'the arbiter is free'.
liveness_gates.control_arm: asserted tiearb_enabled == False -- no arbiter keyword reaches the rust config at all
liveness_gates.preflight: scratchpad/preflight (n=20, B=16): tiearb_enabled=True B=16 J=4 argmax salt=tiearb2-deploy-v1 eps=0.0, 6 fired / 10 tile plies, 4 pickchanges, 0 errors, 0 partial_argmax, 7.176 s/fired ply

measurement_condition.screen: ON at minimum brightness, debug BenchActivity held in front for the WHOLE session (baseline included)
measurement_condition.cpuset: /top-app, verified before the session and before every run
measurement_condition.power: unplugged, verified; fuel-gauge current_now/voltage_now sampled at ~1 Hz on the device clock, trapezoid-integrated over each run's window
measurement_condition.note: gross J/move includes the screen; the net column subtracts an idle baseline measured in the SAME screen-on/top-app condition

projection_constants.t_phone_source: PHASE_A.md §1 rho_phone denominator -- the shipped phone champion's WHOLE-GAME s/move
projection_constants.caveat: A 48-move run samples the OPENING, which is both cheaper per move and tie-richer than the game average. rho_phone_measured therefore divides by 1.551 (comparable to the 5.520 prediction); the session-control-relative figure is reported beside it, never instead of it.

safety.install: adb install -r of the debug apk only; never uninstall/pm clear
safety.e4_archive: files/games/ untouched (6 games before and after); carc_bench refuses an out_dir named 'games'
safety.current_game: none in progress at session start (no files/current_game.json); MainActivity never launched -- BenchActivity only

artifacts.results.json: full report incl. per-arm stats and the tiearb_cost block
artifacts.runs/*.json: per-run device results (move_hash, per-move ms, per-decision arbiter seconds, cumulative arbiter telemetry)
artifacts.device_build.txt: ro.build.fingerprint (this phone rides an Android preview channel)
